messages:
Maria: Quick thread — next week's social sprint for the launch. Need final copy for X + LinkedIn, hero image (1:1 and 16:9), and CTAs. Also planning a short tweetstorm around the benchmark blog + webinar CTA. Who can own assets + scheduling?

Jon: I can draft the X copy and the thread outline. Want the tone tight + technical but friendly. Any required hashtags?

Olivia: @Jon please include #LLMops #Inference if it fits. Also include a link to signup for the webinar. We have a small paid boost budget for the top-performing X post.

Sam: I can take the hero images. Specs? file types? source Figma?

Maria: Specs: 1200x1200 (square) and 1920x1080 (16:9). PNG for LinkedIn hero, JPG for X card OK. Figma: https://figma.redwood/team/launch-sprint (use the deck art — I added frames). Sam, I'll drop the logo variants in the file.

Sam: Got it. Will export + deliver by Tue EOD. Any alt text needs?

Maria: Yes — short alt text for accessibility. 1 sentence.

Kevin: For scheduling: timezone spread — target NA mornings + EU afternoons. Proposed windows:
```
- 09:00 PT (US west morning)
- 12:00 ET (US east midday)
- 15:00 GMT (EU afternoon)
```
Use Buffer for X and Sprout for LinkedIn. I can queue once copy + assets are final.

Jon: Draft of main X post (short variant): "Benchmarking inference cost & latency — how we got 2x throughput for cheaper ops. Join our webinar to see the config + k8s hints. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar #LLMops"

Jon: Thread outline (short):
1) Hook: surprising throughput gains we saw.
2) Quick stat + image.
3) How we configured batching/quantization (link to blog).
4) Invite to webinar + registration.

Olivia: Looks good. For LinkedIn we should expand into a 2-3 paragraph post that highlights enterprise use cases and SLA improvements. I'll draft that after Jon's outline.

Sam: Uploaded drafts to Figma exports folder: https://figma.redwood/team/launch-assets/exports If someone can't access ping me.

Jon: Two X copy lengths below — pls choose:
- Short (280 char): "Benchmarking inference: 2x throughput, 30% cost reduction. See what changed and how your app can scale. Webinar + demo: https://redwood.ai/webinar #LLMops #AI"
- Shorter (xy): "2x throughput, 30% cheaper — our inference playbook. Webinar: https://redwood.ai/webinar"

Maria: Use the first short one for the paid boost candidate. Add hero image A (the performance chart).

Olivia: Budget: $300 for a 48hr boost. Target: US + UK devs and infra leads. Kevin, please set targeting.

Kevin: Will do. Also setting up link UTM params: utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch&utm_medium=paid

Jon: Quick note on engagement follow-ups — suggested reply templates when people ask for details:
- "Thanks! We run a quick eval deck, happy to share the blog and sign you up for a demo: https://redwood.ai/demo"
- "Short answer: we tuned batching + quantization profile; I can DM a config snippet if useful."

Maria: Can Marketing Ops bake the reply templates into the social playbook? We want consistent answers.

Olivia: I'll add them to the shared doc. Also can someone own day-1 monitoring? Need whoever's watching replies + DMs for the first 24 hours.

Jon: I can monitor X replies for the first day. Sam can watch LinkedIn comments.

asana-bot: Task created: "Export hero images for launch" assigned to Sam, due 2026-03-24.

Sam: Confirmed. Delivering images + alt text by Tue EOD.

Maria: Final checklist before scheduling:
- Copy final (Jon)
- LinkedIn longform (Olivia)
- Hero images + alt (Sam)
- Scheduling windows + UTM (Kevin)
- Boost budget live (Olivia)
- Reply templates in doc (Olivia)

Maria: If all owners confirm, Kevin queue posts Wed morning. Anyone blocked?

Jon: Confirmed — copy done, will post final to the doc tonight.

Olivia: Confirmed — LinkedIn draft starting in the doc.

Kevin: Confirmed — will queue once final assets + copy are in Buffer.

Sam: Confirmed.

Maria: Great — thanks everyone :rocket:
